profile.headline: UI Engineer
profile.summary:
Summary:
•	20+ years of IT experience with 9+ years of solid experience in Web Development.
•	Expertise developing large scale SPA using Javascript, React (16.8) and Redux.
•	Strong web development skills with HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Less/Sass, Bootstrap, JavaScript (ES5/ES6), React, Redux, jQuery AJAX and JSON
•	Expertise in React and working with Redux architecture for complex state management and using React Router and ES6 to develop Single Page Applications.
•	Experience in Middleware and libraries such as redux-thunk to implement Asynchronous request/response promise, and Asynchronous code execution.
•	Experience refactoring and migrating legacy applications to ReactJS with experience using Axios and High Order Components.
•	Expertise in working with JSON data format, consuming RESTful Services, and implementing AJAX call in JavaScript, React axios and ReactJS.
•	Well versed in CSS Pre-Processors as SASS to add nested rules, variables, selector inheritance, developing Responsive/Adaptive Web Design using CSS Bootstrap framework.
•	Experience JavaScript using Closure, Promise, Inheritance, AJAX and experience in both Object-oriented Programming and Functional Reactive Programming.  
•	Experience implementing ES6 features such as Arrow function, Class, Module, Set and Map etc.  
•	Hands-on experience in creating frontend Unit Test suites using Jasmine and Karma, and end-to-end test using Protractor.  
•	Great experience in task runners Grunt and Gulp, and Version Control tools GIT, SVN. 
•	Designing test plans for performance and stress testing with tools like Silk Performer 3.0/3.5. 
•	Hands-on experience with Java RMI, JNI, servlets, C++, RPC calls, and serial port communication.
•	GUI on NT using VC++ (MFC).
•	Proficiency in C, C++, MFC, Java programming and RMI.
•	Design and development with visual IDE tools like Visual C++, Visual Basic, and Visual Café. 
•	Proficiency in database connectivity using JDBC/ODBC/DAO/RDO/ADO with Oracle and SQL Database.
•	HTML and XML.
•	Oracles 8i database modeling.
•	Assembly language programming with 6805, 8051 microcontroller.

positions.title: React Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: Weehawken, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Working with UBS as a Frontend Developer for their Financial Advisory products for their clients.

positions.title: React FrontEnd Developer
positions.description:
Worked as React Frontend developer to develop the AIR (Affordable Care Act (ACA) Information Return) prototype development for IRS to file the forms 1095B and 1094B online.   Creating the Manifest File for given Transmission information, Details, and File Metadata. Submitting the form online with JSON format and generating receipt ID on successful submission. Developed UI pages for Search Pages to search the records by TCC (Transmission Control Code), Receipt ID, and UTID (Unique Transmission ID). Developed and Implement UI to upload the ACA Manifest Form and ACA Form 1094B/1095B in XML format.

•	Developed the UI Pages For Form 1095B and 1094B 	and implemented Form Validation and responsive website Using React Bootstrap.
•	Use Axios to integrate with Backend API for Form Submission, File Upload, and Search Pages UI pages.
•	Worked with the IRS person to decide the workflow and UI requirements and enhance the application functionality and add features in prototype development. 
•	Worked closely with Backend Team to integrate UI and display results on Rest API calls.

positions.title: React Developer
positions.description:
Project Description:  Worked as React Frontend developer to develop the web site for Disability Claim services Process for Social Security Administration. It consists of Office of Appellate Operations (OAO), Office of Hearing Operations (OHO) and Disability Determination Services (DDS) component. After a Disability Claim is filed, the disability Process begins at over 1200 Social Security Field Offices. 
•	Developed the UI and integrate with Backend Ajax Rest API call to generate the Correspondence Letter for Claim cases to send a notice and letter to Claimant and Appeals Councils.
•	Used React Flux based Architectural with Action and Store for state to be retrieved from PostgreSQL DB. 
•	Handle Client-side validation for all UI forms, User the Common UI component Library and modularize the development.
•	User version One for stories and Defect declaration by Systems Analyst and Scrum Master and used Bitbucket version controls and code review with Jenkins CI/CD tools.

positions.title: UI Engineers
positions.description:
Developed new features in walmart.com web application for checkout page using React JS, Redux, NodeJS and React Bootstrap UI. Also working on migrating a legacy web application developed in AngularJS to React and fixing bugs in production using React and Redux.

Responsibilities:
•	Used React 16.8 with Redux to create reusable UI components to render view pages
•	Created react component architecture for complex modules and managing state precisely along with using React Hooks and Axios.
•	Extensively used React JS components, Forms, Events, Keys, Router concept
•	Utilized React-Redux Action Creators, created Store from redux library to connect reducers and containers to make state mutations predictable 
•	Applied React-Router to turn application into Single Page Application
•	Handled all the client side validations, slide show, hide and show controls, dropdown menus and tab navigation using React
•	Used ReactJS code for making calls (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for triggering or fetching data from Restful API's provided by the backend team 
•	Used axios for making AJAX calls to consume Restful API
•	Developed client’s website screens and front-end widgets using React JS
•	Beautified application’s UI using Material UI and created customized components for different services using CSS 3, Reactstrap 5 and Bootstrap 3
•	Followed Agile methodology during SDLC, with regular SCRUM sessions and bi-weekly sprint sessions to discuss the project progress and assign user stories as per the sprint backlogs
•	Worked with the team of architects and back-end developers to gather requirements and enhance the application functionality and add new features
•	Implemented unit tests with Jest and Enzyme, used Postman to test REST request
•	Used HTML, CSS, JavaScript in the webpages and experienced with writing APIs 
•	Implemented NPM for front-end dependency control
•	Worked on JIRA for tracking and updating the JIRA tickets
•	Utilized GitHub as version control tool for code review

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked on TripAdvisor marketing platform, building tools for high volume emails sends and push notifications and enrichment with complex data parsing; managing sponsored placements and third party advertisement placements on the integral product; migrating legacy frontend codebase to latest tech stack.

Responsibilities:
•	Developed Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React-Router and to enable navigation from one view to the next as clients performs application tasks.  
•	Involved writing modules using React as a view engine to build component-based application. 
•	Created reusable React components and managed application state with Redux. 
•	Applied redux middleware using redux-thunk and redux-saga. 
•	Used redux-form to manage form state in redux. 
•	Used axios to configure HTTP request and get JSON data from back-end.
•	Applied Object-Oriented Programming techniques to track UI components being added to DOM and to change the behavior of framework methods. 
•	Used High-Order Component to improve component reusability. 
•	Applied Semantic UI to design user interface such as Accordion, Tab and Modal. 
•	Refactored the client-side validation to decouple the UI, reduced dependency and event listeners.  
•	Used AJAX calls and requesting JSON information through REST APIs to fetch data and secure client’s information from server asynchronously. 
•	Used Webpack as module bundler and Babel for compiling and build component based React architecture and SASS preprocessing for configuring tasks. 

Environment: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, ES6, React, Redux, SASS, Axios, AJAX, Mocha, Bootstrap, SVN, Bower, Gulp, Jenkins, JIRA, Babel, Webpack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on multiple applications/teams consisting of banking, health care, insurance and internal Infosys projects.

Responsibilities:
•	Design, development, testing and maintenance of UI and server side code for a platform/framework and associated applications designed to create and manipulate reports based on large sets of consumer related metric data.
•	Development of the client code was primarily in Flex/ActionScript for the initial release of the application. Currently development efforts are being migrated to a Java (GWT/Sencha)/HTML5 solution.
•	Development of UI/Front-End using Javascript, jQuery, HTML5, CS3, Bootstrap, RWD.
•	Designed web page structure using HTML, CSS.
•	Produced client side validation through JavaScript and Ajax for asynchronous communication.
•	Produced the report data on the client side Front-end using JavaScript, HTML, CSS.
•	Used Ajax and JQuery to keep the reviews up to date on web pages.
•	Used JQuery UI widgets to enhance the web application user experience.
•	Handled Browser compatibility issues for different browsers related to CSS and HTML.
•	Development of the server side code is Java/JavaEE with Oracle for the persistence layer.
•	Technologies used - Java/JavaEE 6 (POJOs, EJB3, CDI, JPA/Hibernate, JAXB, JAX-RS, JAX-WS, Servlets, JSP), HTML4/5, GWT, Sencha, JavaScript, jQuery, Flex 4, ActionScript 3, Spring, XML, Oracle, SQL/SP’s, IDEA IntelliJ, Eclipse, FlashBuilder 4, Tomcat, JBossAS 7, SVN/Subversion/Subclipse

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Working as Self Employed Entrepreneur  as post of General Manager at company Manufacturing Pressure Calibrator (Pressure comparator and Dead Weight Tester) and Temperature Calibrator ( Dry Block and Liquid bath Temperature Calibrators) in INDIA. Companies also engage in calibration activities for pressure, Temperature, Flow, Mass, Weight, Dimension, Humidity and Electrical parameter measurements. Lead and Developed the Calibration Reporting software using JAVA, mySQL  and Crystal Report to log and monitor the calibration activity and generate calibration report.

positions.title: Sr. software Lead Engineer and Consultant
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Working as a Sr. software lead engineer to develop the EMS system with Hp Openview NNM 6.2 for LMDS broadband wireless access system, which deliver a high bandwidth data, voice and video services to CPE. 

Involved in developing detail functional specification, design and development. Develop web interface for configuration Management and background task for discovery, configuration and trap action for HP openview NNM 6.2. 

 Extensively used mimic simulator 4.2 with tcl/tk scripting to simulate the hardware device for testing and stress testing on Network Management Application..

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Managed a Network Management Project for a various start up companies in BAY Area like Optimight (a core fiber optical network company offer a great bandwidth with WDM technology over longer distance), Accordion Network (a on site broadband service company enable service provider to deliver a rich variety of voice, data, video and advance IP and ASP services to business tenant unit). Developed the NMS using Adventnet NMS 2.2 with MySQL and Oracle 8i Database.Designed the configuration, fault and performance management of the system with customization of adventnet Web NMS and managed objects with persistent storage on database. Designed a test plan for performance checks, Integration and built. Customized Adventnet for performance, fault and auto discovery. Implemented the complete fault management with event correlation and alarm status propagation.
   	
Worked as software Engineer for developing the CFML (Cold Fusion Markup Language) based e-commerce corporate Gift Giving Web site.  Systems was based on MS IIS 4.0 web server and Cold Fusion Application Server in a Window NT 4.0 with Oracle 8i database. Developed reusable custom CF tag with CFML and CFX custom tag in Visual 5.0 for cyber source integration. 
●	Designed a test plan and performed a stress testing on the entire Web Site with Silk Performer 3.0/3.5 using BDL scripting. Load testing include test environment set up, (Setting up multiple computers as agents and controller), recording and customizing BDL scripts, dynamic loading on web site with multiple user simulation, generating graphical performance analysis reports and summary reports etc.
●	Development of functional specifications and user flow diagrams, design object and database model
